descriptionHtml:
This session is proudly organized as part of the IEEE Day 2026 celebrations at the University of Peradeniya.
Join us for a hands-on workshop on hardware acceleration focusing on Xilinx FPGA boards. Professional skills covered include:

  • Fundamentals of RTL and digital logic design

  • FPGA synthesis and hardware acceleration

  • Functional verification and performance analysis

  • FPGA deployment and toolchain implementation
venue: Drawing Office II, Faculty of Engineering
